articles.title: Revolut receives in-principle approval from UAE authorities for crypto services
articles.snippet: Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority approved the London-headquartered fintech company for broker-dealer, management and investment, and exchange services in the UAE.

articles.title: This Is How Much Your Boyfriend Is Spending on AI Girlfriends
articles.snippet: Romantic AI companion apps have brought in nearly half a billion dollars as users pay for virtual partners, flirting, and digital intimacy.
